description_short: Vegetated strips (grass and/or woody) along watercourses that intercept sediment/nutrients, stabilise banks, shade streams and provide habitat; established by planting or by protecting/restoring natural riparian vegetation.
description_technical: Riparian buffers are linear NbS placed along the watercourse network. Suitability is reasoned per establishment driver: F1 planted buffers (grass/herbaceous filter strips or woody/forested buffers) gated by watercourse proximity, riparian slope/width, adjacent-land runoff load and the planting envelope; F2 natural/restored riparian vegetation gated by existing riparian condition / regeneration potential and hydro-connectivity. Footprint is zonal_linear (buffer length per stream-km, never pixel area). Floodplain/hydro-reconnection is registered but parked pending a river-restoration scope call. Distinct from agroforestry linear plantings (windbreaks/contour buffers), which are gated by wind/slope-flow on farmland, not the watercourse network.
